overview: BookBank.bh is a community-driven book sharing platform where users can lend, borrow, and donate books for free. Features email/password accounts, smart book search powered by Google Books to find exact editions, and real-time in-app messaging between borrowers and lenders.
features: Email and password sign in and sign up
Google Books search to find exact book editions
Community library with search and filters
In-app chat after request is accepted
